reliability.rationale: The nitrate-free selected predictor has8.85346umol/kg group-MAE versus9.94856 flexible and19.8098 depth-only; it wins54/64 profiles. This supports the stated limited surrogate, not a universal oxygen-nitrate relation.

mechanism.rationale: Temperature/salinity/depth water-mass structure is compatible with oxygen observations; solubility is an in-situ-temperature surface-equilibrium proxy, not pressure-corrected AOU. Biological consumption and mixing remain confounded.

novelty.rationale: Prior physical/statistical families are disclosed. This bounded literature check does not certify new laws or exhaustive novelty.

significance.rationale: Useful reproducible prediction or informative failure within a precisely scoped cohort; no automatic discovery score.

reproducibility.rationale: Inspected executable equation, coefficients, source/task definitions and saved group results; independent numerical execution belongs to the separate computational reviewer.

impact.rationale: No independent intervention, deployment-cost study or external experimental replication.

limitations: Two floats sampled serially;64 profiles are not64 independent ocean systems. Adjusted and synthetic aligned products include author processing and possible later calibration. Nitrate eligibility restricts the selected model cohort despite nitrate-free equation.
Scientific-critical agent review is advisory; it is not human expert adjudication or independent experimental replication.
recommendations: Pre-register oxygen-only eligibility if testing nitrate-free deployment; use independent floats, sensor adjustment uncertainty and potential-temperature solubility before a broader biogeochemical interpretation.
